package.Description:
DuoDash 1.1.3 with integrated 427x240 fullscreen correction. Two apps side by side on the CarPlay screen Runs apps that have no CarPlay support of their own on the car screen as live, interactive scenes - two at once, side by side, at a split you drag to any ratio. Configure it in Settings > DuoDash.

key_references.label: Performance Tweak
key_references.footerText: Performance Tweak is still in beta and could cause serious problems on your iPhone. After you turn Optimize CPU And Thermal on or off, reconnect CarPlay for the change to take effect — unplug and replug the USB cable, or disconnect and reconnect wireless CarPlay.

key_references.label: Optimize CPU And Thermal
key_references.footerText: Lowers the CarPlay frame rate so the car screen keeps up and the phone runs cooler, and helps the car screen recover instead of dropping out when the phone is overloaded.

key_references.label: Close Unloaded Pane Apps
key_references.footerText: When you choose a different app for a DualApps pane, closes the app that was in it so it stops using memory and CPU. Closed apps do not reopen by themselves: music stops, and unsaved work in that pane is lost. The app you are using on the phone itself is never closed.

key_references.label: Headunit Info
key_references.footerText: For better performance and less heat, set video quality in YouTube, Plex and similar video apps to the Recommended video quality or lower.

Penyetelan Performa masih dalam tahap beta dan dapat menyebabkan masalah serius pada iPhone Anda. Setelah Anda mengaktifkan atau menonaktifkan Optimalkan CPU dan Suhu, sambungkan ulang CarPlay agar perubahan diterapkan: cabut dan pasang kembali kabel USB, atau putuskan dan sambungkan ulang CarPlay nirkabel.

Saat kamu memilih aplikasi lain untuk sebuah panel DualApps, menutup aplikasi yang tadinya ada di panel itu agar berhenti memakai memori dan CPU. Aplikasi yang ditutup tidak terbuka sendiri: musik berhenti, dan pekerjaan yang belum disimpan di panel itu hilang. Aplikasi yang sedang kamu pakai di ponsel sendiri tidak pernah ditutup.
